name: Travel Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A tic-tac-toe board with nine recessed wells and inlaid grid lines, plus five pieces for each player: X and O, or star and heart. Print it as a flat board, or as a box that stores all ten pieces under a sliding lid whose top is the board. Four colours: board, grid, and one per player. Everything prints flat without supports.
source: inspired by Printables Tic-Tac-Toe Game Set (Easy To Print) (#996434, 5796 downloads) and Tic Tac Toe in a box (#68328, 3360 downloads)
